# Agent Entry Point: agentic-sdd-framework

This project follows the Agentic SDD Framework. Before any task, read:

1. `.agents/AGENTS.md`: non-negotiable rules for this repository.
2. `.agents/CONTEXT.md`: incident registry, technical debt, and non-goals.
3. `docs/SPEC.md`: the active specification (Lite mode).

## Skills

Load a skill from `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` only when its trigger applies.

| Skill | Load when |
| :--- | :--- |
| `strategic-cto` | Choosing a stack or architecture, or answering "can this be improved?" |
| `auditor-executor-protocol` | Work spans several phases or sessions, or another agent implements the plan |
| `fix-and-verify` | Fixing a reported bug, including a vague one with no repro steps, in a single session |
| `no-ai-slop` | Writing documentation, user-facing copy, or commit messages |
| `ast-navigator` | Exploring code. Active adapter: `ast-grep` (`.agents/skills/ast-navigator/adapters/ast-grep.md`) |

## Adding a Rule

`.agents/AGENTS.md` is the only place a project rule lives. If the user asks to add one
("always do X", "never do Y", "remember this constraint"), do not write it to memory, to
CLAUDE.md, or to a temporary or unrelated doc -- none of those are read by every agent, or
checked by the gate. Run:

```
node scripts/sdd-add-rule.js --title "<short title>" --rule "<the operating rule>" --why "<why this rule exists>"
```

It appends a correctly numbered, tagged rule block; it refuses empty fields and bracket
placeholders. If the rule replaces one of the 8 defaults with an equivalent of your own,
add `--fulfills=<id>` (see the tag above the rule you are replacing in `.agents/AGENTS.md`)
so the constitution check still recognizes it as fulfilling that slot.

## Project Facts

* Runtime: node-24-lts
* Specification mode: lite
* Configuration: `sdd.config.json`

## Before Every Push

Run `node scripts/quality-gate.js`. It must exit 0. The pre-push hook runs it automatically, and it checks the specification as well as the code: a checked task or `DONE` report without pasted evidence fails.

Record task evidence with `node scripts/sdd-verify.js --task <ID> -- <command>` and close `docs/SPEC.md` with `node scripts/sdd-verify.js --record`; the gate rejects a `Completed` spec whose recorded PASS does not match the committed content.
